name: MHA without value embeddings
tagline: Native full attention with value embeddings removed: the shared control.
description: The full-attention shell with every value-embedding table and gate removed, independently calibrated within the shared budget. It separates the effect of value embeddings from changes to attention, and is the shared full-attention control for the KDA + MLA-NoPE hybrid and its components.
paperTitle: nanochat: value embeddings in the shared shell
mechanism: Value embeddings and their gates removed; everything else native
limitations: A paired control, not a new method. Registered and admitted within the shared budget; no formal result is published yet. Parameters, memory and speed are outcomes, not controls.
